description: Validates storage conventions, migration hygiene, persistence seams, and test isolation through storage-manager.

capabilities.label: Target Classification
capabilities.description: Scenario resolution, service metadata, API surface language, and storage applicability classification.

levels.name: Storage target unavailable
levels.description: The target scenario cannot be resolved or its storage surface cannot be classified.
levels.capability_summary: Storage Health cannot classify the target scenario.
levels.next_unlock: A readable scenario with service metadata and classifiable API/storage surfaces.

levels.name: Target classified
levels.description: The scenario and its storage applicability are readable enough for storage checks.
levels.capability_summary: The target storage surface is classified.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum target-classification maturity.

levels.name: Classification clean
levels.description: Storage applicability is known and downstream checks can run without fallback classification.

capabilities.label: Schema Substrate
capabilities.description: Declared storage engines, embedded schema placement, idempotent DDL, and schema wiring.

levels.name: Substrate unknown
levels.description: The storage substrate or schema location cannot be evaluated.
levels.capability_summary: Schema substrate cannot be trusted yet.
levels.next_unlock: Recognized storage substrate and readable embedded schema.

levels.name: Substrate recognized
levels.description: Declared storage engines are recognized and schema files can be inspected.
levels.next_unlock: Schema is embedded, idempotent, CREATE-only, and wired through the supported seam.

levels.name: Schema coherent
levels.description: Embedded schemas are idempotent, ALTER-free, and wired through the supported schema seam.
levels.capability_summary: Schema structure is coherent for local lifecycle and tests.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum schema-substrate maturity.

levels.name: Schema clean
levels.description: Storage substrate and embedded schema checks are clean.

capabilities.label: Isolation Safety
capabilities.description: Routed database seams, variant-aware namespaces, and fail-closed destructive-test isolation.

levels.name: Isolation unknown
levels.description: Storage isolation cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Routed storage seams can be inspected.

levels.name: Isolation inspectable
levels.description: Storage isolation seams and namespace usage can be inspected.
levels.next_unlock: Routed seams and variant-aware namespaces are proven.

levels.name: Isolation safe
levels.description: Destructive E2E playbooks are statically routed to isolated test storage and variant-aware namespaces.
levels.capability_summary: Storage isolation is safe for destructive test workflows.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum isolation-safety maturity.

levels.name: Isolation clean
levels.description: Storage isolation checks are clean.

capabilities.label: Persistence Hygiene
capabilities.description: Repository-layer storage access, per-domain schema ownership, rows lifecycle, and deadlock-resistant SQLite usage.

levels.name: Persistence surface unknown
levels.description: Persistence access cannot be evaluated.
levels.capability_summary: Persistence hygiene cannot be checked yet.
levels.next_unlock: Persistence access patterns can be inspected.

levels.name: Persistence inspectable
levels.description: Persistence access and schema ownership patterns can be inspected.
levels.next_unlock: Repository-layer seam usage, per-domain schema ownership, rows closure, and deadlock safety.

levels.name: Persistence hygienic
levels.description: Persistence access follows storage seam conventions and avoids known deadlock/resource leaks.
levels.capability_summary: Persistence access is hygienic enough for maintained local operation.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum persistence-hygiene maturity.

levels.name: Persistence clean
levels.description: Persistence hygiene checks are clean.

capabilities.label: Operational Readiness
capabilities.description: Backup target registration and stage-appropriate migration debt visibility.

levels.name: Operational posture unknown
levels.description: Operational storage readiness cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Scenario maturity stage and durable-data dependencies are readable.

levels.name: Operational posture visible
levels.description: Backup and migration posture can be reported.
levels.next_unlock: Backup target and migration debt advisories are resolved where applicable.

levels.name: Operationally ready
levels.description: Backup and migration advisories are clean or intentionally not applicable.

capabilities.label: Declaration Accountability
capabilities.description: Whether declared storage matches observed writers, paths, sidecars, budgets, and enforcement.

levels.name: Declaration unknown
levels.description: Storage declarations cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: A readable owner manifest and storage surface.

levels.name: Declared
levels.description: The owner has a readable declaration, but reconciliation is incomplete.
levels.next_unlock: Reconcile declared paths with writers and observed bytes.

levels.name: Reconciled
levels.description: Declared paths, writers, sidecars, and observed storage agree.
levels.next_unlock: Bound and enforce every durable surface.

levels.name: Governed
levels.description: Reconciled storage is bounded and enforcement is visible.
levels.capability_summary: Storage declarations are governed end to end.

capabilities.label: Filesystem Portability
capabilities.description: Portable runtime roots, separators, temporary files, and path containment across supported platforms.

levels.name: Filesystem portability unknown
levels.description: Filesystem portability cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: A readable owner root and portable path contract.

levels.name: Filesystem portability inspectable
levels.description: Filesystem paths and writer surfaces can be inspected.
levels.next_unlock: Portable resolver roots and safe temporary/rename behavior.

levels.name: Filesystem portability safe
levels.description: Managed paths use portable roots and containment-safe writes.
levels.capability_summary: Filesystem paths are portable and bounded.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum filesystem-portability maturity.

levels.name: Filesystem portability clean
levels.description: Filesystem portability checks are clean.

capabilities.label: Filesystem Safety
capabilities.description: Ownership, modes, atomic replacement, symlink safety, and managed cleanup boundaries.

levels.name: Filesystem safety unknown
levels.description: Filesystem safety cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: A readable owner root and writer surface.

levels.name: Filesystem safety inspectable
levels.description: Ownership and writer behavior can be inspected.
levels.next_unlock: Explicit modes, atomic writes, and symlink-safe boundaries.

levels.name: Filesystem safety governed
levels.description: Managed writes and cleanup use reviewed safety seams.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum filesystem-safety maturity.

levels.name: Filesystem safety clean
levels.description: Filesystem safety checks are clean.

capabilities.label: Retention Governance
capabilities.description: Retention policy, active-use protection, durable-data protection, cleanup authority, and auditable enforcement.

levels.name: Retention governance unknown
levels.description: Retention policy cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: A readable owner policy and cleanup authority.

levels.name: Retention policy visible
levels.description: Retention and protection rules can be inspected.
levels.next_unlock: Eligible candidates, active protection, and durable protection.

levels.name: Retention governed
levels.description: Cleanup is bounded by policy, protection, approval, and audit seams.
levels.next_unlock: Maximum retention-governance maturity.

levels.name: Retention clean
levels.description: Retention governance checks are clean.

SCHEMA_NOT_IDEMPOTENT.reason: Adding IF NOT EXISTS or restructuring non-idempotent DDL can change semantics; needs author judgment.

SCHEMA_HAS_ALTER.reason: ALTER belongs in a migration, not the embedded schema; relocating it requires deciding migration ordering.

FILE_ROUTED_SEAMS_UNWIRED.reason: Routing file persistence through request-context roots requires adapting each store's path construction and write accounting.

STORAGE_ISOLATION_UNVERIFIED.reason: Isolation cannot be statically proven for a non-Go API; porting to the Go seams or adding an equivalent mechanism needs author judgment.

SCHEMA_NOT_PER_DOMAIN.reason: Splitting a shared schema into per-domain files requires deciding which domain owns each table.

SYSTEM_SQL_NOT_EMPTY.reason: Tables in the system schema must be re-homed to a domain the author selects.

CROSS_DOMAIN_HARD_FK.reason: Relaxing a cross-domain foreign key requires a deliberate ownership/consistency decision.

RAW_SQL_OPEN.reason: Replacing a raw sql.Open with the routed database.Open seam is a repository-layer refactor needing judgment.

ROUTED_DRIVER_IMPORT.reason: Removing a direct SQL-driver import means routing through api-core/database, a repository-layer change.

SQL_DB_HANDLE_CAPTURE.reason: A captured *sql.DB struct field must be replaced with context-routed access; the call sites need rework.

DIRECT_SQL_IN_HANDLERS.reason: Moving SQL out of a transport handler into a repository function is a structural refactor.

SQLITE_POOL_DEADLOCK.reason: Resolving a MaxOpenConns:1 nested-query deadlock means restructuring the query flow, not a mechanical edit.

BACKUP_TARGET_MISSING.reason: Registering a data-backup-manager target is an operational decision about what data is durable.

MIGRATION_DEBT.reason: Migration debt is informational; authoring a migration is a deliberate, stage-dependent act.

STORAGE_ENTRY_NO_WRITER.reason: A writer may be missing, generated, or intentionally suppressed; remediation needs owner judgment.

STORAGE_OWNER_GATE_FAILED.reason: The storage-manager suite gates resource, tool, and safeguard declaration errors and blockers.

STORAGE_OWNER_GATE_ADVISORY_TREND.reason: Advisory drift is reported by the suite without blocking adoption.

STORAGE_ENTRY_CLASS_CONFLICT.reason: The owner must choose the correct class for durable versus regenerable data.

STORAGE_ENTRY_UNRECLAIMABLE.reason: The owner must provide a reclaim command or measured budget.

STORAGE_SQLITE_SIDECAR_UNDECLARED.reason: The owner must declare live SQLite sidecars alongside the database.

STORAGE_BUDGET_BELOW_OBSERVED.reason: The owner must reconcile observed bytes with its declared ceiling.

STORAGE_RETENTION_CONFLICT.reason: The owner must make retention and durable-data declarations agree.

STORAGE_PATH_UNACCOUNTED.reason: The owner must adopt observed bytes into an accountable declaration.

STORAGE_PATH_ORPHANED.reason: The stale scenario directory must be removed or given a canonical owner manifest.

STORAGE_PATH_NOT_PORTABLE.reason: Choosing a portable token or an explicit per-platform map requires owner knowledge of the upstream layout.

STORAGE_PATH_PLATFORM_MISMATCH.reason: Correcting a platform mismatch requires deciding whether the declaration or its applicability is wrong.

STORAGE_PATH_BRANCH_MISSING.reason: The owner must add a branch or explicitly declare absence with null.

STORAGE_TOKEN_SUPERSEDABLE.reason: Replacing repeated platform branches with one token requires confirming the logical location.

STORAGE_ACCOUNTABILITY_UNDECLARED.reason: Without a storage.entries declaration the durable surface cannot be evaluated, so no higher rung can be claimed. Blocks L1; the owner sits at L0.

STORAGE_ACCOUNTABILITY_UNRECONCILED.reason: A declaration that disagrees with observed writers, paths, sidecars, or ceilings is declared but not reconciled. Blocks L2; the owner sits at L1.

STORAGE_ACCOUNTABILITY_UNGOVERNED.reason: Reconciled storage with no budget and no reclaim command has no visible enforcement. Blocks L3; the owner sits at L2.

FILESYSTEM_DIRECT_WRITER.reason: A direct filesystem mutation can recreate ownership, mode, atomicity, or symlink defects.

FILESYSTEM_MODE_UNPROVEN.reason: A writer with an implicit or dynamic mode cannot prove restrictive permissions across platforms.

FILESYSTEM_NONPORTABLE_PATH.reason: An absolute or platform-specific writer path does not survive portable deployment.

RETENTION_AUTHORITY_MISSING.reason: Regenerable data without bounded retention or an owner provider cannot be reclaimed safely.

RETENTION_POLICY_MISSING.reason: Missing policy is conservative: cleanup is refused until the owner surface is declared.

STORAGE_TARGET_UNRESOLVABLE.reason: An unresolved target cannot be inspected; resolution must be restored before storage maturity can be assessed.

STORAGE_TARGET_UNCLASSIFIED.reason: A target that cannot be classified cannot safely select storage checks or ownership policy.

STORAGE_CLASSIFICATION_INCOMPLETE.reason: A partially classified target cannot provide a stable owner and storage contract.

SCHEMA_SUBSTRATE_UNRECOGNIZED.reason: An unrecognized storage substrate cannot be checked for embedded schema ownership or lifecycle safety.

SCHEMA_SUBSTRATE_UNCLEAN.reason: The schema substrate is not ready for clean maturity until embedded, idempotent, per-domain schema checks are satisfied.

STORAGE_ISOLATION_UNINSPECTABLE.reason: Uninspectable storage routing cannot prove destructive tests are isolated.

STORAGE_ISOLATION_UNCLEAN.reason: Isolation is not clean until every destructive storage path is routed and verified as fail-closed.

PERSISTENCE_SURFACE_UNINSPECTABLE.reason: Uninspectable persistence access cannot prove repository ownership, schema placement, or resource closure.

PERSISTENCE_HYGIENE_UNCLEAN.reason: Persistence hygiene is not clean until repository access, schema ownership, row closure, and deadlock safety are proven.

OPERATIONAL_POSTURE_UNREADABLE.reason: Unreadable backup and migration posture prevents safe operational storage decisions.

OPERATIONAL_READINESS_UNPROVEN.reason: Operational readiness requires an explicit, resolved backup and migration posture.

FILESYSTEM_ROOT_UNINSPECTABLE.reason: Without a readable managed root, path portability and containment cannot be verified.

FILESYSTEM_PORTABILITY_UNGOVERNED.reason: Portable paths require resolver-owned roots and containment-safe write and rename behavior.

FILESYSTEM_PORTABILITY_UNCLEAN.reason: Filesystem portability is not clean until supported-platform roots, separators, temporary files, renames, and containment are verified.

FILESYSTEM_SAFETY_UNINSPECTABLE.reason: Without writer and ownership evidence, filesystem safety cannot be evaluated.

FILESYSTEM_SAFETY_UNGOVERNED.reason: Safe filesystem mutation requires explicit modes, atomic replacement, symlink-safe boundaries, and ownership repair.

FILESYSTEM_SAFETY_UNCLEAN.reason: Filesystem safety is not clean until ownership, modes, atomic replacement, symlink handling, and cleanup denial tests are green.

RETENTION_GOVERNANCE_UNINSPECTABLE.reason: Retention cannot be safe when owner policy and cleanup authority are unreadable.

RETENTION_GOVERNANCE_UNBOUNDED.reason: Enforceable retention requires bounded candidates, active and durable protection, approval, and audit evidence.

RETENTION_GOVERNANCE_UNCLEAN.reason: Retention governance is not clean until policy precedence, protected data, active leases, cleanup authority, audit, and repair retry are proven.

fallback.reason: When no specialized storage finding applies, the owner remains at the conservative persistence-hygiene level until evidence is available.

determinism.reason: Storage validation measures observed on-disk usage against declared budgets and inspects live databases for migration and isolation hygiene. Both read host filesystem and database state that changes without any file in the scenario changing.
